{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for 'LOYAL' in customer_segment
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].str.lower().unique()

# Check status values
status_values = df['status'].unique()

# Check revenue dtype and sample
revenue_dtype = df['revenue'].dtype
revenue_sample = df['revenue'].head(5)

# Print findings
print(f'LOYAL exists in data: {loyal_exists}')
print(f'Status values: {status_values}')
print(f'Revenue dtype: {revenue_dtype}')
print(f'Revenue sample: {revenue_sample.tolist()}')"}
